verifiedFacts: V15 copies session observations into studio_guided_publication_observations.observation (V15:112-117). The capture guard requires equality with s.progress->'observation' (:163). studio_guided_publication_preparations holds execution_evidence, proposal and proof (V15:123-145). Its guard requires execution_evidence = s.progress->'executionEvidence' (:167).

Capture happens DURING the session, not at publish. GuidedPublicationConfiguration:122-125 writes the base at session start when studio.guided.publication.enabled. :129-141 writes the preparation and question evidence. application.yml:205 sets the default to enabled (STUDIO_OBSERVED_PUBLICATION_ENABLED:true). GuidedPublicationEvidenceRepository.captureQuestion:27-31 skips only when no base exists. Consequence: sessions that never publish (FAILED/CANCELLED/EXPIRED/abandoned) also leave copies. The X6/RK-13 framing ('copied into publication tables') did not state this.

The tables are append-only. tr_publication_immutable is BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE on bases/observations/preparations/admissions/publications (V15:298-303), and tr_publication_attempt_delete is at :304. There is no delete path.

Observations are NOT IDs/codes only. ObservationNode has role, name and locatorHints with string values. Observation has origin. A node classification may be permittedBusinessData or nonsecretApproved, from read grants. Source: studio-runner/src/run/observationTypes.ts:6-24,32-38. Password controls and knownSecrets are withheld (types :12,47).

Replay verifies provenance by hash. publicationEvidenceHash is compared receipt vs provenance at ObservedRevisionVerifier:205. A grep of ObservedRevisionVerifier, ObservedReplayAuthorization, ObservedReplayAuthorizer and ProgressReportService found no read of studio_guided_publication_observations or _preparations rows. GuidedPlanPublisher reads them during publish (evidence.read at :204, :354, :442).

decision1_X6.question: Does OBS-014 AC-3 retention/pruning cover the sanitized observation/execution-evidence copies in the immutable V15 publication tables?
decision1_X6.ruling: OTHER: split by whether the session published.

a_publishedSessions.decision: RETAINED as publication provenance for as long as the publication row exists, which is indefinite because V15 has no delete path. Not pruned by OBS-014.
a_publishedSessions.rationale: The copies are hash-bound into the receipt (publicationEvidenceHash) and provide the audit trail for why the published plan is what it is. AC-3 itself says 'the receipt and exact plan must survive'. Pruning them needs a change to the V15 immutability model, and there is no product reason to break provenance in this wave.
a_publishedSessions.oracle: The AC-3 IT asserts these rows are byte-unchanged after a prune and that replay still verifies. 'Pruned content is gone' does not apply to them.

b_neverPublishedSessions.scope: Terminal sessions with no studio_guided_publications row, capture closed (V15:158-159 state set or expires_at elapsed), window elapsed (same predicate as AR-2c)
b_neverPublishedSessions.decision: IN SCOPE for AC-3. The observation-bearing content (observation, execution_evidence, proposal) is pruned under AC-3's window.
b_neverPublishedSessions.rationale: These are the same sanitized observations and model-derived proposals that AC-3 exists to stop keeping indefinitely (ADR-SC-005 Panel evidence 3, P0 'retention of sanitized observations and model output'). They have no publication-integrity purpose. Pruning progress while an identical immutable copy stays would make AC-3's 'pruned content is gone' oracle false. This applies the AC's title and intent; it is not a new feature.
b_neverPublishedSessions.mechanism: @architect (AR-2e): row delete or content nulling, FK order admissions -> preparations -> observations -> bases/attempts, and the form of the studio_publication_immutable relaxation. Constraints from this ruling: forward-only V19/V20 (D lane) only, never an edit to V12-V18. The relaxation permits only sessions with no publication row. Negative tests show every published session's rows stay immutable.
b_neverPublishedSessions.fallback: If AR-2 rules (b) unsafe for this wave, @po re-rules. A dropped (b) becomes a named residual in the AC-2 document and the OBS-010 compliance gate, and @pm schedules a follow-up story. Never passed by omission.

decision1_X6.disclosureObligation: AC-2 guided-data-flow.md names the four publication tables (bases, observations, preparations, admissions). It lists their field-level content: role, name, locatorHints values, origin, and permittedBusinessData/nonsecretApproved content where a read grant exists. It states explicitly that the content is not IDs/codes only. It states retention: (a) indefinite with the integrity rationale; (b) pruned with the window. The OBS-010 external compliance approval relies on this document. OBS-010 text is not edited by this ruling.
consideredAndRejected: Pure (a), retaining all publication copies: rejected because capture happens for every session, including never-published ones. 'Retained as part of the published revision' is false for those, and indefinite retention of their observations is exactly the residual AC-3 targets.

Pure (b), pruning published copies too: rejected for this wave. It breaks hash-bound publication provenance, the AC-3 text requires receipt and plan integrity, and it needs a V15 immutability redesign. It stays available if Security & Compliance refuses the indefinite retention at the OBS-010 gate. That would be a new story, @architect first.
